items.title: GLM-5.3 open weights are downloadable
items.oneliner: Open-weight coding model with Docker, Colab, and Transformers support, plus a claimed 50% jump on Z.ai Code Bench.

items.title: scc 4.0 finds risky code hotspots
items.oneliner: Fast codebase analyzer that combines complexity and commit history to surface files most likely to need maintenance.

items.title: htmx 4.0 is ready to ship
items.oneliner: HTML-first web library now uses fetch(), standardizes events, and keeps old apps working during migration.

items.title: The Twelve-Factor App was updated
items.oneliner: Canonical deployment playbook for cloud apps, refreshed for 2025 with concrete rules for config, processes, and scaling.

items.title: This handbook focuses on analytical AI
items.oneliner: Practical guide for building measurable decision systems with smaller models, lower latency targets, and operations-first evaluation.

items.title: This guide hardens local dev environments
items.oneliner: Actionable walkthrough for isolating risky code with containers, VMs, and dedicated machines to reduce supply-chain blast radius.

items.title: Binvis makes binaries visually inspectable
items.oneliner: Browser-based binary viewer for ELF and PE files that helps reverse engineers spot structure, sections, and anomalies quickly.

items.title: EasyEffects upgrades Linux laptop audio
items.oneliner: PipeWire effects tool that can dramatically improve weak laptop speakers with EQ, compression, and per-device tuning.

items.title: This mesh volume trick is worth stealing
items.oneliner: Compact geometry tutorial showing how to compute triangulated mesh volume fast using the divergence theorem.

items.title: Sesame is a local-first password manager
items.oneliner: Open-source desktop password manager with vault import, 2FA storage, backups, and no cloud dependency by default.
